title: Three Mondays and One Short File
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：instance　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 instance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the lawyer ① noted the instance that no citizen in the court would have described, and he said the noting was the whole of the Monday. The ② instance, meaning the case itself and not the folder, ran three Mondays and stayed undescribed in the book; a instance, he said, is the only thing in a court that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ instance in that court had the same short folder beside it, and the ④ instance at the far bench, meaning the record they kept for the children to study and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A instance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the lawyer said the describing is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the instance was the whole of the matter, meaning the example and not the case. The ⑥ instance, meaning the example and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; instance, he said, is either something you note or the only word that means both a case and a example. He said the example is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ instance had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short folder. The ⑧ instance of the whole thing, the lawyer wrote in March, was one court and three Mondays of describing; instance, he said, is either the record at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ instance I remember is the case described in the file, which closed in 2003 and is still described as the quietest in the court. A ⑩ instance, my mother said in 2005, is the only case that improves by being described; every instance, she said, is a example that has agreed to look like a case. She said the example was the honest half.

options: A. n. 实例；事例（指法庭里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 实例；事例（指那个事例本身，与卷夹相对）
C. 固定搭配：note the instance 记下这个实例
D. n. 实例；事例（指留给孩子们研读的一份那一个）
E. n. 个案之事（抽象总称，指一处法庭的实例之事）
F. n. 实例；事例（指卷宗里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 例子、先例（指一件事里人人都举却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 先例（抽象总称，指人人都举却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: note the instance 意为“记下这个实例”，1996 年那位律师把法庭里没有一位市民肯描述的一个实例做了一遍。
instance 意为“实例；事例”，指那个事例本身而不是卷夹，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被描述。
instance 意为“实例；事例”，指法庭里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个薄薄的卷夹。
instance 意为“实例；事例”，指最远那条长凳留给孩子们研读的一份那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
instance 意为“例子、先例”，指一件事里人人都举却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个先例就是那件事的全部。
instance 意为“先例”，指人人都举却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个事例，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
instance 意为“实例；事例”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 2001 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
instance 意为“个案之事”，律师三月写道，整件事的实例之事是一处法庭和三个星期一的描述。
instance 意为“实例；事例”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一个，2003 年立案了，至今仍被说成法庭里最安静的一个。
instance 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，实例是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的事例。
